checkpoints.name: AC entrance
checkpoints.instruction: Go under the canopy and through the glass entrance doors.

checkpoints.name: Main hall
checkpoints.instruction: Go up the short steps beside the noticeboards.

checkpoints.name: Electrical Engineering corridor
checkpoints.instruction: Follow the long corridor toward the light at the far end.

checkpoints.name: AC dean’s office corridor
checkpoints.instruction: Continue along the corridor, past the opening on your right.

checkpoints.name: Electronics corridor
checkpoints.instruction: Go through the glass doors at the end of the corridor.

checkpoints.name: Noticeboard corner
checkpoints.instruction: Follow the corridor around the noticeboard.

checkpoints.name: Stairwell entrance
checkpoints.instruction: Take the stairs through the open double doors.

checkpoints.name: Stair landing
checkpoints.instruction: Continue up the stairs to floor 4.

checkpoints.name: Stair landing by the display hall
checkpoints.instruction: Leave the stairwell through the glass doors into the display hall.

checkpoints.name: Display hall
checkpoints.instruction: Take the opening beside the glass display wall.

checkpoints.name: B419 doorway
checkpoints.instruction: Go through the marked door into Lab B419.
